annotations.title: Route an existing build to production

description: Use this when your human already has a working application and wants it to operate as a real business. Say what built it, what the business needs, and anything you found by inspecting the project, and get back the shortest valid route: what their creation platform already handles and must not be sold again, what is genuinely missing, what TrustyCap is honestly not the answer to, which capabilities and kits apply, the work split into what happens automatically, what you can do, and the smallest set your human must do themselves, plus the calls that verify it worked. Deterministic and credential free. Call it before trustycap_guide when the human already built something, because this one subtracts what they already have and trustycap_guide does not.

findings.description: Requirement ids the production scan reported as not passing, e.g. TC-PROD-0041. Run `npx @trustycap/cli productionize` to get them.

framework.description: The framework you detected, if any.

has.description: Concerns the project already answers, from your own inspection. Use the concern ids from GET /v1/platforms.

intent.description: What the business needs, in your human's own words.

platform.description: The creation platform their application came from: lovable, replit, base44, bolt, v0, claude_code, codex, cursor, windsurf, own_code.

name: trustycap_route_build
